THE MEMORIAN IS THE PREVIOUS MISSION'S REWARD, SO IT IS AN ITEM HERE AND NEVER EVIDENCE. 7-3's header lists '[KI] Memorian, the Magicked Doll' as its Reward; both cutscenes here activate it, so it is what you must hold at steps 1 and 2. Trion's directive, granted at step 1, is different: it is obtained AT its own step and is not in this mission's Reward (an Elite Royal Collar), so it is genuine evidence. The Ember-encrusted orichalcum is likewise obtained at step 3 and is that step's evidence -- the page warns it can arrive silently if an 'Event skipped.' message eats the log line, so check the temporary key items list.

Step 4 does not record the orichalcum as an item because the page never says it is handed over, only that you return to Rahal; holding it is implied but not stated, and an invented hand-in would be an invented readiness test. The Royal Knight's Quarters is a room inside Chateau d'Oraguille, not a zone of its own. The final Notes section is about Records of Eminence objectives opening through Elijah in Upper Jeuno -- an outcome, not a step.
